name: draft-session
description: v2_s6 Draft session guard: injects the Draft contract from the refresh-agent checkout, runs draft-lint on /draft-done, and blocks the Draft receipt until lint passes. A cloud session (no service role) pins itself with draft_pin and gets the credentialed CI lint dispatch instead of a local lint.

runId.title: Refresh run id
runId.description: refresh_runs.id this session drafts for. Leave empty and use /draft-start <run_id> <article_id> instead.

articleId.title: Article id
articleId.description: articles.id of the run's article (== refresh_runs.article_id).

slug.title: Article slug (optional)
slug.description: Lets the guard also pin file edits and --slug writes to this article.

templateVariant.title: Run template (v1 | v2 | standard)
templateVariant.description: refresh_runs.page_variables.template_variant. Empty or unknown is treated as v2 (the strict side): the receipt stays locked unless the V2 method rules ran.

contractPath.title: Path to stages/v2_s6_draft.md
contractPath.description: Checkout of bbm-refresh-agent. Empty = try /home/user/bbm-refresh-agent and ../bbm-refresh-agent.
